## Explanation

Release **1378.0.0**. This PR bumps `@metamask/social-controllers` from
`3.14.1` to `3.14.2` (patch) to ship
[#11209](https://github.com/MetaMask/core/pull/11209), which passes the
realtime feed item's `authorComment` through from the backend instead of
deriving it from trade comments. The root monorepo version is bumped to
`1378.0.0`, as the release check requires.

`1378.0.0` is the next number after `1377.0.0`
([#11203](https://github.com/MetaMask/core/pull/11203)). An earlier
`1378.0.0` attempt
([#11205](https://github.com/MetaMask/core/pull/11205)) was reverted in
[#11207](https://github.com/MetaMask/core/pull/11207) before anything
was published, so there is no `1378.0.0` tag.

Packages deliberately left out of this release:

- `@metamask/base-controller`, `@metamask/base-data-service`,
`@metamask/controller-utils`, `@metamask/messenger`, and
`@metamask/profile-sync-controller` are marked `intentionally-skip` in
the release spec. `social-controllers` depends on them, but their
unreleased changes are test, tooling, and dev-dependency changes with no
consumer-facing API or behavior change.
- Other packages with unreleased changes on `main` (for example
`@metamask/kyc-controller`) are not part of this release.
